name: Southern Star Highland Trails Pipeline
monitor_reason: concrete step: only a nonbinding open season (June 15 to July 20, 2008) for about 346 mi of 36 in, 0.7-1.0 million Dth/d, Conway County Arkansas to Rockies Express in Audrain County Missouri. No FERC filing, no precedent agreement, no later news found; nothing shows it proceeded. Not an existing GEM row (distinct from Fayetteville Express P0189).
researcher_notes: Not a match to an existing row. A Natural Gas Intelligence article from 2008 (two URLs, same origin) reports the open season. A web search found no later filing or build evidence. Likely abandoned. Left as monitor, not a new row, because no step beyond a nonbinding open season is sourced. If Baird counts an open season as a concrete step, the values above are ready, but status would more likely be shelved or cancelled by inference.
